blocks.textLatin: Am – Second person singular: You

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱩᱱᱤ - Uni (He / She / That person)
blocks.textLatin: Uni – Third person singular: He or She

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱵᱚ - Abo (We all - inclusive)
blocks.textLatin: Abo – We (including the listener): You and I together

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ - Ale (We - exclusive)
blocks.textLatin: Ale – We (excluding the listener): Us, but not you

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱟᱯᱮ - Ape (You all - plural)
blocks.textLatin: Ape – Second person plural: You all

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱩᱱᱠᱩ - Unku (They / Those people)
blocks.textLatin: Unku – Third person plural: They or Those people

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱪᱮᱫ - Ched (What?)
blocks.textLatin: Ched – Used to ask about things, objects, or actions

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱚᱠᱚᱭ - Okoi (Who?)
blocks.textLatin: Okoi – Used to ask about people and identities

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱚᱠᱟ - Oka (Which / Where?)
blocks.textLatin: Oka – Used to ask about places, locations, or selections

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱛᱤᱥ - Tis (When?)
blocks.textLatin: Tis – Used to ask about time, dates, and schedules

blocks.textOlChiki: ᱪᱮᱞᱠᱟ - Cileka (How?)
blocks.textLatin: Cileka – Used to ask about condition, manner, or quality

blocks.textOlChiki: -ᱨᱮ (-re: in / at / on)
blocks.textLatin: -re – Locative marker (e.g., Oṛak-re = in the house, Atu-re = in the village)

blocks.textOlChiki: -ᱠᱷᱚᱱ (-khon: from)
blocks.textLatin: -khon – Ablative marker (e.g., Atu-khon = from the village)
